title: ChatCompletionRequest

messages.description: A list of messages representing the conversation history. Supports roles: `system`, `user`, `assistant`, and `tool`.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model slug to use for completion, such as `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro`. Find available models at [Model APIs](https://app.baseten.co/model-apis/create).

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens based on how frequently they appear in the text so far. Positive values decrease repetition. Support varies by model.

logit_bias.title: Logit Bias
logit_bias.description: A map of token IDs to bias values (-100 to 100). Use this to increase or decrease the likelihood of specific tokens appearing in the output.

logprobs.title: Logprobs
logprobs.description: If `true`, returns log probabilities of the output tokens. Log probability support varies by model.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position (0-20). Requires `logprobs: true`. Log probability support varies by model.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. If your request input plus `max_tokens` exceeds the model's context length, `max_tokens` is truncated. If your request exceeds the context length by more than 16k tokens or if `max_tokens` signals no preference, context reservation is throttled to 49512 tokens. Higher `max_tokens` values slightly deprioritize request scheduling.

n.title: N
n.description: Number of completions to generate. Only `1` is supported.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens based on whether they have appeared in the text so far. Positive values encourage the model to discuss new topics. Support varies by model.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Specifies the output format. Use `{"type": "json_object"}` for JSON mode, or `{"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {...}}` for structured outputs with a specific schema.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for deterministic generation. Determinism is not guaranteed across different hardware or model versions.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Up to 32 sequences where the API stops generating further tokens. Can be a string or array of strings.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: If `true`, responses are streamed back as server-sent events (SSE) as they are generated.

stream_options.description: Options for streaming responses. Set `include_usage: true` to receive token usage statistics in the final chunk.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness in the output. Lower values like 0.2 produce more focused and deterministic responses. Higher values like 1.5 produce more creative and varied output.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only consider tokens with cumulative probability up to this value. Lower values like 0.1 produce more focused output.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: A list of tools (functions) the model may call. Each tool should have a `type: "function"` and a `function` object with `name`, `description`, and `parameters`.

tool_choice.title: Tool Choice
tool_choice.description:
Controls which tool (if any) the model calls.

- `none`: Never call a tool.
- `auto`: Model decides whether to call a tool.
- `required`: Model must call at least one tool.
- `{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "..."}}`: Call a specific function.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: If `true`, the model can call multiple tools in a single response.

user.title: User
user.description: A unique identifier for the end-user, useful for tracking and abuse detection.

best_of.title: Best Of
best_of.description: Number of candidate sequences to generate and return the best from. Only a value of 1 is supported.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Limits token selection to the top K most probable tokens at each step. Lower values like 10 produce more focused output. Set to -1 to disable.

top_p_min.title: Top P Min
top_p_min.description: Minimum value for dynamic `top_p`. When set, `top_p` dynamically adjusts but does not go below this value.

min_p.title: Min P
min_p.description: Minimum probability threshold for token selection. Filters out tokens with probability below `min_p * max_probability`.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Multiplicative penalty for repeated tokens. Values greater than 1.0 discourage repetition, values less than 1.0 encourage it.

length_penalty.title: Length Penalty
length_penalty.description: Exponential penalty applied to sequence length during beam search. Values greater than 1.0 favor longer sequences.

early_stopping.title: Early Stopping
early_stopping.description: If `true`, stops generation when at least `n` complete candidates are found.

bad.title: Bad
bad.description: Words or phrases to avoid in the output. Support varies by model.

bad_token_ids.title: Bad Token Ids
bad_token_ids.description: Token IDs to avoid in the output. Support varies by model.

stop_token_ids.title: Stop Token Ids
stop_token_ids.description: List of token IDs that cause generation to stop when encountered.

include_stop_str_in_output.title: Include Stop Str In Output
include_stop_str_in_output.description: If `true`, includes the matched stop string in the output.

ignore_eos.title: Ignore Eos
ignore_eos.description: If `true`, continues generating past the end-of-sequence token.

min_tokens.title: Min Tokens
min_tokens.description: Minimum number of tokens to generate before stopping. Useful for ensuring responses are not too short.

skip_special_tokens.title: Skip Special Tokens
skip_special_tokens.description: If `true`, removes special tokens from the generated output.

spaces_between_special_tokens.title: Spaces Between Special Tokens
spaces_between_special_tokens.description: If `true`, adds spaces between special tokens in the output.

truncate_prompt_tokens.title: Truncate Prompt Tokens
truncate_prompt_tokens.description: If set, truncates the prompt to this many tokens. Useful for handling inputs that may exceed context limits.

echo.description: If `true` and the last message role matches the generation role, prepends that message to the output.
echo.title: Echo

add_generation_prompt.description: If `true`, adds the generation prompt from the chat template, such as `<|assistant|>`. Set to `false` for completion-style generation.
add_generation_prompt.title: Add Generation Prompt

add_special_tokens.description: If `true`, adds special tokens like BOS to the prompt beyond what the chat template adds. For most models, the chat template handles special tokens, so this should be `false`.
add_special_tokens.title: Add Special Tokens

documents.description: A list of documents for RAG (retrieval-augmented generation). Each document is a dict with string keys and values that the model can reference.
documents.title: Documents

chat_template.description: A custom Jinja template for formatting the conversation. If not provided, uses the model's default template.
chat_template.title: Chat Template

chat_template_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the chat template renderer.
chat_template_args.title: Chat Template Args

disaggregated_params.description: Advanced parameters for disaggregated serving. Used internally for distributed inference.

description: Request body for creating a chat completion.
